propositions: Cancelled ACLI link-delete commands (exit non-zero on stdin EOF) are counted as applied links instead of failures, causing links_applied to equal computed even when zero links were removed.

The except-arm handling subprocess.CalledProcessError in _update_one_dispatch_links treats all failures as idempotent 404/409 races without verifying the error message, producing silent permanent divergence rather than transient self-healing.

acli link create and link delete subcommands accept --yes flag (verified against 1.3.19-stable) but are not called with it, causing stdin=DEVNULL to trigger confirmation prompts that read EOF and exit with 'command cancelled'.

The narrowed idempotent check must inspect both stderr and stdout (per delete_issue precedent at acli.py:739), not stderr alone, to detect 404/not-found markers that can land on stdout when --json is unsupported.
A new links_failed counter must ride the outcome dict and print in batch_outcome to make the silent-divergence visible to REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP canary checks.
